name: Coffee Pub Merchant
tagline: Mark an actor as a merchant and their token becomes a shop.
description: Turns merchant actors into shops that players open by double-clicking the token. Shelves with finite or restocking stock, trading hours, markups and haggling, atomic buy and sell, and mail-order catalog delivery.
pitch: Turn any actor into a shop. Players browse illustrated shelves and buy and sell in one step, with haggling, restocking and mail-order delivery.

features.title: Token becomes a shop
features.text: Mark an Actor as a merchant; double-clicking its token opens the shop for GMs and players.

features.title: Flexible shelves
features.text: Shelves are unlimited, finite, or restock on a cadence of in-world days; stock by drag, compendium search or roll tables.

features.title: Pricing and haggling
features.text: Per-shop and per-shelf markup, plus a Negotiate shelf where the GM sets the price.

features.title: One-press trades
features.text: A buyer's slate handles buying and selling together; goods and coin transfer together or not at all.

features.title: Trading hours
features.text: Closed shops can be browsed but not traded with.

features.title: Mail order
features.text: Pay now, deliver later by Ground, Courier Beast or Parcel Portal, tracked with receipts.

steps: Open an Actor sheet, click Merchant Settings, and turn on Is a merchant.
Name the shop, pick a Category, optionally apply a Shop profile, and stock shelves by dragging items, searching compendiums or rolling tables.
Place the merchant's token on a scene and double-click it to open the shop.
